experiment: E2 — prefill TPS + impact of the KV cache on the bus at long contexts S=65k/131k/262k, single GPU (CUDA1) (ROADMAP blocks 1+7)
status: prepared: code and grid ready; run not executed — waiting for user launch (GPU1 must be free)

model.arch: L=48; 40 local SWA layers (window=1024, kv_dim=2048) + 8 global full-attention layers blk.5/11/../47 (kv_dim=512); vocab=262144, lm_head tied
model.note: ~7.05 GB; S* ≈ 412k > context_length 262144 — the whole E2 range is below the point where KV outweighs weights (E1/C-11)

gpu.device: RTX 5060 Ti #2 (non-display card), CUDA device name CUDA1
gpu.requirement: close the SECOND LM Studio instance before running (~10.7 GiB on GPU1/CUDA1) — otherwise OOM at S>=131k; the chat-backend instance lives on GPU0 and does not interfere with this run

grid.repetitions: prefill: r=2 for S<=131072, r=1 at 262144; decode: r=2 everywhere
grid.ctx_sizing: b11819 has no -c flag: ctx auto = n_prompt + n_gen (+n_depth); prefill cell ctx=S (KV grows to full size inside the timed window), decode cell ctx=S+64

metrics.primary_prefill: Pure prefill TPS: the `pp{S}` row (t/s ± std). KV is written inside the timed window — the metric captures KV's impact on the bus during prefill
metrics.primary_decode: Pure decode TPS after an S prefix: the `tg64 @ d{S}` row; depth prefix outside the timing window (E1 mechanism, -d/--n-depth)
metrics.why_pp_row_valid_here: In E1 the combined pp+tg row was unsuitable as a decode metric; here the pp row itself is the target prefill metric
metrics.theory_ref: inference_math.prefill_flops (tests 14/14): @65536 ≈ 2.04e15, @131072 = 5_200_878_642_397_184 FLOP (exact), @262144 ≈ 1.49e16; tps_prefill_ceiling(tflops_eff) — compute-bound side of the roofline for comparison with the measurement

vram.f16_S262k_total_gib: ~12.0-12.5 (weights ~7.05 + global-layer KV ~4.3 GiB + SWA window constant ~0.34)
vram.q8_0_note: q8_0 KV halves the linear part — more headroom

time_estimate: ~1-2 hours (estimate: prefill_flops at tflops_eff≈30 TFLOPS gives ~68 s/rep @65k, ~173 s @131k, ~497 s @262k; decode cells add their own prefill to the timing outside the window — but the run does them too)

preflights_in_bat: B: -m fake model -dev CUDA1 → 'invalid device' = fail (~2 s, no VRAM)
C: one real prefill cell f16 S=1024 r=1 — findstr 'pp1024'; checks the pp row format and model loading on CUDA1 (short VRAM spike)
launch_protocol.logging: raw/run_log.txt: timestamp + exact command line + exit code of every cell; raw/pp_{kv}_S{S}.txt and tg_d{S}_{kv}.txt — full cell output
user_steps: 1. Close the second LM Studio instance (the one holding ~10.7 GiB on GPU1)
3. Wait for 'E2 done' in the console (estimate 1-2 h)
launch_protocol.note: QWEN_NO_PAUSE=1 disables pause; an OOM cell does not drop the grid — bat continues, exit code and OOM text go to run_log/raw

deliverables_5_files_protocol: table.md (table: S × kv → pp t/s ± std and tg64 @ d{S} TPS ± std, OOM cells marked)
plot.png (pp TPS(S) for 2 quantizations + theoretical prefill_flops ceiling; decode TPS(S))
conclusion.md (findings: KV on the bus during prefill/decode at long S; C-xx in CONCLUSIONS.md after measurement)
